name: room_empty_1
prompt: This is an upscaled crop of a photoreal audio-plugin UI. Output ONE image, landscape 1536x1024, with EXACTLY the same framing, scale, perspective, lighting, colours and every detail as the input, so it overlays the input pixel for pixel. Change ONLY this: remove the whole musical instrument (the steel guitar body, its strings, fretboard, chrome bar, legs and all their shadows) so the room is empty. Where it was, continue the same Persian rug pattern naturally across the floor, with the same soft warm lighting, and the same blurred room background (amps, lamp, wall) at the top. The cream top bar and the dark control deck at the bottom stay exactly as they are. No instrument, no furniture, no shadows of them: just the empty rug and room.
